국내 웹매거진 추천 가이드 · 패션·뷰티·컬처 웹 매거진 정리 (2026: Korean Web Magazines: A Guide to Fashion, Beauty & Culture Web Magazines (2026) | PAP MAGAZINE
A web magazine is a magazine founded on the web and published through the web and social media. This guide first explains four criteria for choosing a Korean web magazine, then lists the Korean web magazines active in fashion, beauty and culture by category. PAP Magazine is one of them.
웹매거진은 종이 잡지의 디지털판이 아니라 처음부터 웹에서 창간한 잡지입니: A web magazine is not the digital edition of a print title but a magazine founded on the web from the start. With no print deadline it publishes whenever there is something to publish, and articles, editorials, videos and Instagram posts are made within one editorial flow. The older word "webzine" loosely covers any magazine put online; "web magazine" refers to a title born on the web.
최근의 국내 웹매거진은 세 갈래로 나뉩니다. 웹사이트가 중심이고 소셜은: Korean web magazines today fall into three groups: sites where the website is the core and social media is the notification channel, Instagram magazines that started on Instagram and expanded to the web, and titles that ran web and Instagram together from the start. In every case readers actually read in two places, the web and Instagram, so look at both when choosing.
2. 국내 웹매거진을 고르는 기준 네 가지: 2. Four criteria for choosing a Korean web magazine
남의 보도자료와 사진을 옮기는 매체인지, 직접 기획하고 촬영하는 매체인지: Whether a title reposts other people's press releases and photos or plans and shoots its own work decides its value.
최근 한 달 게시물 가운데 자체 제작 화보·인터뷰·기사가 몇 편인지 센다: Count how many of last month's posts are in-house editorials, interviews and articles.
웹매거진은 쉽게 창간하고 쉽게 멈춘다. 2년 이상 꾸준히 발행한 매체가: Web magazines are easy to start and easy to stop. A title that has published steadily for two years or more is trustworthy.
Check the date of the first post in the archive and the gap between recent posts.
팔로워 수는 과거의 누적이고, 게시물당 좋아요·저장·공유는 지금의 독자다: Follower count is an accumulation of the past; likes, saves and shares per post are the readers of today.
팔로워 규모가 비슷한 매체끼리 최근 게시물 10개의 평균 반응을 비교한다: Compare the average engagement of the last 10 posts between titles of similar follower size.
화보·필름을 직접 만들 수 있는지, 어떤 포토그래퍼·브랜드와 일하는지가: Whether a title can shoot its own editorials and films, and which photographers and brands it works with, determines content quality.
Look at the people and partner brands listed in the credits.

4. 광고를 집행할 수 있는 웹매거진: 4. Web magazines you can advertise with
브랜드가 웹매거진에 광고를 집행할 때는 팔로워 수보다 게시물당 반응과 인: When a brand advertises with a web magazine, engagement per post and whether an insight report is provided matter more than follower count. Saves and shares mean readers found the content worth returning to or passing on, which makes them the most honest measure of advertising effect. Check whether the title shares reach, saves, shares and profile-visit insights after the campaign, whether a collaborator post lets the brand see the same numbers in its own account, and whether web placement links carry UTM tags to track traffic.

Second, it runs a network of eight themed Instagram accounts rather than a single account. Third, it is a Korean-first title that publishes the same content in nine languages, so international readers and creative teams read it too.
국내 웹매거진 추천해 줄 수 있나요?: Can you recommend Korean web magazines?
분야에 따라 다릅니다. 패션·뷰티·컬처 전반과 오리지널 화보를 보려면 P: It depends on the field. For fashion, beauty and culture with original editorials, PAP Magazine; for fashion and lifestyle news and trend curation, eyesmag; for street fashion and sneakers, Hypebeast Korea; for street culture and music, VISLA; for tech and lifestyle reviews, THE EDIT; for lifestyle curation, ON CURATION. When choosing, look at four things rather than follower count: the share of original content, publishing longevity, engagement per post and production capability.
웹매거진과 웹진, 디지털 매거진은 어떻게 다른가요?: How do web magazines, webzines and digital magazines differ?
웹진은 웹에 올라간 잡지를 두루 가리키는 오래된 말이고, 디지털 매거진은: "Webzine" is an older word that loosely covers any magazine put online, and "digital magazine" is a broad term that includes the digital editions of print titles. A web magazine is one founded on the web from the start, with no print edition. The websites of Vogue Korea or Elle Korea are digital magazines but not web magazines; PAP Magazine and eyesmag are web magazines.
웹매거진과 인스타그램 매거진은 어떻게 다른가요?: How do web magazines and Instagram magazines differ?
인스타그램 매거진은 인스타그램을 주 발행 채널로 삼아 편집된 콘텐츠를 정: An Instagram magazine uses Instagram as its main publishing channel and regularly releases edited content, while a web magazine is centred on a website. The line has blurred recently: some start on Instagram and expand to the web, and others, like PAP Magazine, have run both since founding. For readers the difference is where they read the same content; for advertisers it is whether insight reports and web-link tracking are available.
광고를 집행할 수 있는 국내 웹매거진은 어디인가요?: Which Korean web magazines accept advertising?
대부분의 웹매거진이 인스타그램 피드·스토리 게시와 웹 기사 게재 형태의: Most web magazines accept advertising as Instagram feed and story posts and web article placements. Rather than follower count, check saves and shares per post, whether an insight report is provided after the campaign, whether collaborator posts are possible, and whether web links carry UTM tracking.
